title: Photography review · Foundation
summary: A concise first review of image suitability before detailed creative approval.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

blocks.text: Confirm that the image is technically usable before spending time on detailed creative judgement. Resolution, crop flexibility, colour integrity and source-file quality should be known first.

sections.heading: Then judge the image as MOSCATELLI

items: Does the image feel controlled rather than busy?
Is the product or subject represented truthfully?
Does the light support material and form?
Would the image remain credible alongside the rest of the house?
